Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for D8 Night tabletop character animations.
Image 1 is the identity/style reference for anteros. Preserve exact face, hair, body proportions, clothing, colours and illustration linework. Change only poses; no costume redesign.
Create a strict 4-column by 10-row contact sheet of 40 separate FULL BODY character cutouts on genuinely transparent background. Each equal cell contains ONE entire character, centered with 20% transparent margin; never touch adjacent cells. No text, borders, shadows, backdrop, grids, scenery or floating disconnected props. Same apparent body size in ALL cells, all facing south/front three-quarter. For the seated reference remove the chair and stand in the same outfit.
Within each row the FOUR columns are successive animation frames, chronological left to right:
row 1 jump: crouch preparation, rising push-off, airborne knees tucked, landing crouch.
row 2 climb: reaching up, pulling with opposite arm, lifting leg, next handhold.
row 3 swim: alternating swimming arm strokes, body slightly forward but full body with legs visible, no water.
row 4 dodge: alert, duck left, lean right, recover.
row 5 stealth: crouched slow sneak four alternating foot steps.
row 6 search/study: glance left, bend examine, hand shade eyes, thoughtful recovery, no book or extra props.
row 7 ready: raise hands defensively, poised stance, tense anticipation, poised recovery.
row 8 interact/help/talk/use-object: reach one hand, gesture inviting, both hands assisting, lower hands.
row 9 fall: stagger, knees buckling, tipping, lying prone full body.
row 10 stand up: lying on side, pushing torso upright, one knee, standing neutral.
All poses anatomically plausible. Keep original adult/child identity and ages, modest original clothing; NO violence/gore. Clean painted fantasy RPG sprites, consistent lighting, crisp readable small-scale silhouettes. EXACTLY 40 separated cutouts in 4 x 10 order.
